title: Eye Doctor Uptown Houston | Disease Treatment
description: As technology changes, it is even more important to visit your Uptown Houston eye doctor who has all the right qualifications and follows the latest developments in eye care.

blocks.html: At [[a href="/hours-location/"]]Briargrove Eye Center,[[/a]] our Eye Care Clinic is committed to keeping all staff members up to date with the latest technology and techniques to make your visit as comfortable and effective as possible. As optometric technology continues to advance, it becomes even more important to choose an eye doctor with the right qualifications and expertise in [[a href="/eye-care-services/eye-conditions/"]]Eye Condition Treatment.[[/a]] By staying current with the latest developments in eye care, we provide patients with high-quality, personalized vision solutions.

Utilizing cutting-edge technology, we diagnose and manage diseases such as glaucoma, macular degeneration, [[a href="/eye-care-services/management-of-ocular-diseases/cataract-surgery-co-management/"]]cataracts[[/a]], and diabetic retinopathy with greater precision. During your[[a href="/eye-care-services/eye-exams/"]] annual eye exam[[/a]], we can often detect these conditions earlier, allowing for more timely treatment and better outcomes. We take an aggressive approach to diseases that previously had few treatment options, and significant advances have been made in the treatment and management of these sight-threatening conditions.

items: [[a href="https://www.briargroveeye.com/eye-care-services/management-of-ocular-diseases/cataract-surgery-co-management/"]]Cataract Surgery Co-Management[[/a]] Cataracts are a common cause of vision loss after age 55. Learn more about recognizing cataract symptoms, protecting your eyes and understanding cataract surgery.

[[a href="https://www.briargroveeye.com/eye-care-services/management-of-ocular-diseases/treating-diabetic-retinopathy/"]]Diabetic Eye Disease[[/a]] Diabetes and vision go hand in hand. If you have diabetes, you need to know that having this systemic disease puts you at greater risk for developing vision problems.

[[a href="https://www.briargroveeye.com/eye-care-services/management-of-ocular-diseases/glaucoma-testing-treatment/"]]Glaucoma Testing & Treatment[[/a]] Glaucoma is a condition that causes damage to your eye's optic nerve and gets worse over time, so nipping it in the bud will always be better for the person being tested.

[[a href="https://www.briargroveeye.com/eye-care-services/management-of-ocular-diseases/treating-macular-degeneration/"]]Macular Degeneration[[/a]] The macula is the portion of the retina which provides sharp, central vision, and is involved in processing the fine details of the image. The breakdown of the macula is a disease called macular degeneration.
